summary.question: Does PI0.5 combine the scene, instruction, and robot state into appropriate, reusable behavior, or does it mainly rely on familiar layouts and generic visual sensitivity?

automatic: Read-only data, prior-artifact, feasibility, and schema checks.
Focused normal-environment tooling and tests required by the next child study.
Preparing a child job manifest and requesting an independent agent audit.
Executing a content-hashed, committed, independently audited child job inside its budget.
Resuming unchanged jobs, recomputing results, and stopping on declared gates.
requires_human: A new scientific question or materially different model, environment, or population.
A larger compute, rollout, or storage budget.
External paid compute, publication, or destructive source-capture removal.
Changing a locked primary metric, cohort, threshold, control, site, or confirmation rule.

child_contract_defaults.lock_rule: A child study cannot execute model or simulator trials until its exact job manifest is content-hashed, committed, and independently audited. Any change to a claim-bearing field creates a new child revision.
required_evidence: exact job and trial manifest with expected count
preflight, command, environment, code, model, dataset, and seed identities
append-only attempts, failures, exclusions, and deviations
full physical action or behavior outputs needed to recompute metrics
strongest controls and all candidate-selection results
independent schema, execution, calculation, and claim audits
machine result card and generated human summary

decision_protocol.branch_rule: Geometry and binding have separate named nodes from behavior discovery through rollout. Every source-bound child names exactly one predecessor. When both sources are positive, both branches activate independently; an agent may not merge them or choose only the easier-looking branch.
decision_protocol.entry_rule: A study becomes eligible only when every requires_all_completed study has a valid terminal result and, when present, at least one requires_any_positive study has a positive audited result. Invalid studies must be revised; they never satisfy an entry condition.
decision_protocol.negative_rule: For an effect study, negative means a prelocked family-level bound shows that the minimum useful effect or required control margin is absent. Merely failing the positive gate is inconclusive. Only a valid confirmed_negative may supersede an exploratory positive; invalid, not_applicable, and inconclusive results never do.

plan.decision_unlocked: Decide whether to pursue a factor-specific internal mechanism, treat PI0.5 primarily as a shortcut or reliability-analysis target, or stop because the policy lacks the behavior required for this mechanistic question.

behavior_results_sealed.rule: A behavior branch activates its matching internal branch only after a confirmed positive. The other behavior branch never selects or closes it.

discovery_sealed.rule: Geometry and binding discovery run independently. Semantic discovery uses discovery families only. Before the first behavior-confirmation trial, every confirmation child activated by a positive behavior discovery result is committed and has a passing independent design audit.

phase_two_locked.rule: All activated semantic and causal confirmation jobs are committed and independently audited before any confirmation-family activation, key/value, readout, or patch output is produced or inspected.

program_terminal.rule: No activated study is runnable or active, every activated branch has a terminal audited result, and no unresolved audit error or unhandled event remains.

distinguishing_predictions: Target displacement produces a matching physical trajectory correction.
Changing the named target routes behavior while pixels remain fixed.
The relationship repeats across task-object families, layouts, and robot starts.
A narrow internal path can transfer the relevant correction selectively.
hypotheses.statement: PI0.5 binds the instructed object to current scene and robot geometry and computes a reusable target-relative control response.

distinguishing_predictions: Discovery effects fail on prospectively held-out task-object families.
Task, layout, prompt, or prior-action predictors rival model internals.
Within-task shuffled scene signals retain most apparent predictive power.
hypotheses.statement: Task and layout patterns explain behavior better than an episode-specific scene relationship.

distinguishing_predictions: Irrelevant-object changes rival target changes after image salience is matched.
Action deltas do not point toward the required target-relative correction.
Intended internal patches do not beat natural wrong-factor controls.
hypotheses.statement: Scene changes perturb the output without a task-specific physical response.

distinguishing_predictions: The action-state main effect is large when scene and current action guess are crossed.
Late scene effects shrink or change meaning when the current action guess is fixed.
Whole late-state replacement remains strong while a narrow scene path does not.
hypotheses.statement: Late expert differences mostly reflect action guesses that have already diverged, not a progressively stronger scene signal.

distinguishing_predictions: Identity decoding survives layout and pose changes without a matching behavior effect.
Instruction changes reveal behavioral use absent under a fixed instruction.
Intervening on the readable signal does not selectively change relevant behavior.
hypotheses.statement: Object information is readable under controlled variation, but its use in the tested behavior has not been demonstrated, or it becomes relevant only under another instruction.

baseline_screen.interpretation: Operational screen only, not a precise policy-success estimate.
baseline_screen.permitted_confirmation_exposure: Baseline competence may be inspected in both pools. Counterfactual actions, internal sites, and intervention outcomes in the confirmation pool may not.

candidate_pool.canonical_family_id: libero_90 task ID, normalized task verb, normalized instructed object, normalized destination or secondary object, joined with ASCII unit separators.
candidate_pool.interleave_rule: Sort strata by sha256 of rq024-stratum-v1 plus the stratum ID. Sort families within each stratum by rank_digest. Repeatedly take one family from each nonempty stratum in that fixed order until 24 are selected.
candidate_pool.rank_digest: sha256 of rq024-family-rank-v1, a null byte, program_id, a null byte, and canonical_family_id encoded as UTF-8. Break digest ties by canonical_family_id.
candidate_pool.selection_rule: Before rollout outcomes are known, enumerate every LIBERO-90 task, parse it with a versioned family parser, preserve every rejection and reason, then apply the exact interleave and rank rules above. Commit the task-catalog, parser, source-universe, candidate-table, and rejection-table hashes.
candidate_pool.stratum: normalized task verb and normalized instructed-object identity

cohort_selection.base_rule: Within each pool, select the first six baseline-eligible families in the precomputed outcome-blind order. Preserve every other eligible family as nonselected evidence; never substitute it after counterfactual results.
cohort_selection.child_structural_rule: If a child needs additional structural support, apply its predeclared outcome-blind structural filter to the same ordered pool and select the first six passing families before any child model output is generated. If fewer than six pass, that child is not applicable; do not backfill it after inspecting another child's result.

population.deterministic_seed_rule: Derive layout, reset, environment, policy, and flow-noise seeds in separate domains from sha256(program_id, child_plan_id, canonical_family_id, cell_id, replicate_id, seed_domain). The child trial manifest stores the resolved integer seeds before execution; one seed may not silently stand in for another.

identity_support.vocabulary_rule: Lock identity labels before the semantic readout. Each claim-bearing label must occur in at least three distinct selected discovery families, and at least three labels must pass. Unsupported labels remain listed but cannot count as decoding failures. This program makes no zero-shot identity claim.

population.inference_rule: Weight task-object families equally and resample hierarchically by family, then layout. Report n_families, n_layouts, n_noise, and n_rollouts. Noise, action elements, tokens, and denoising steps never increase independent n.
nested_units: matched flow-noise sample within scene condition
policy call, action position, token, head, layer, and denoising time within trial

pool_assignment.assignment_rule: Assign even zero-based candidate positions to discovery and odd positions to confirmation until each has twelve families. This assignment is locked before baseline screening. Do not move a family after seeing success or any counterfactual result.

pool_exposure.confirmation: Before a causal-confirmation child is locked, agents may inspect baseline and frozen behavior-confirmation outputs only. They may not compute or inspect confirmation-family activations, token or layer scores, fixed-x outputs, keys/values, patches, or semantic readouts. The first-access log records exposure type, study, agent, artifact hash, and time.
pool_exposure.discovery: Geometry and binding discovery, semantic readout, internal selection, and causal discovery use only discovery families.

required_eligible.failure_rule: If either preassigned pool has fewer than six eligible families, stop the general mechanism program. Do not refill one pool from the other.

program_stop_rules: Never relax competence, control, budget, or confirmation gates after seeing results.
Do not localize internals until a controlled physical behavior effect survives a rollout check.
Behavioral confirmation proceeds independently of success or failure in internal localization.
Any unresolved audit error blocks execution or claim promotion.
Only a valid confirmed_negative supersedes its exploratory positive without erasing either artifact.
Negative, invalid, failed, and superseded studies remain visible.
plan.question: Does PI0.5 combine the scene, instruction, and robot state into appropriate, reusable behavior, or does it mainly rely on familiar layouts and generic visual sensitivity?

environment.execution_rule: Use only the dedicated PI0.5 hardware environment and wrappers.
environment.simulator_rule: Lock LIBERO, robosuite, MuJoCo, task, camera, and controller versions.

scope.freshness: Existing broad-1000 tasks and test data have been inspected and are discovery data. Confirmation in this program means prospectively held out from RQ-024 counterfactual selection, using new scene instances and an exposure log. It must not be described as globally untouched unless a prior-artifact audit proves that stronger statement.

model.checkpoint_revision_rule: Resolve and hash the exact revision in every child contract.

prior_evidence: RQ-015 found exploratory identity information when the simulator region was supplied.
RQ-019 found a reproducible open-loop action difference in five layouts of one task.
RQ-020 established broad visual dependence but no object-specific location.
RQ-022 replaced whole late action states but confounded scene and action-path effects.

Select the first six eligible families in each precomputed pool order.
Preserve later eligible families without using them as outcome-driven replacements.
Create eligible discovery and confirmation manifests without cross-pool replacement.
Lock the family-level precision or bounded-replication interpretation for n equals six.
